intent_snapshot.goal: bun run e2e builds an npm pack tarball install root, serves a scripted mock model from cassettes, launches the pinned real claude binary against it through an extended fake-herdr that spawns Host processes, and completes a smoke journey; e2e files are black-box (no runtime imports) and excluded from bun test; the Pi mock-model feasibility result is recorded in the Spec (Spec D2-D5) (Initiative e2e-release-gate slice S2; Spec docs/specs/e2e-release-gate.spec.md).

acceptance.assertion: bun run e2e smoke packs the package, installs it into a temp root, starts the mock model, launches the pinned claude with ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL at the mock and the built plugin loaded, and completes a one-turn scripted exchange; a cassette whose recorded tool name does not match the requested turn fails with cassette_mismatch. Done looks like: tests/e2e/smoke.e2e.ts passes and its mismatch case asserts cassette_mismatch. Prerequisite: the pinned claude binary from tests/e2e/hosts.json is installed on the QA host (maintainer machine provides claude 2.1.330); an absent binary fails the check rather than skipping.

A file under tests/e2e/ that imports a plugins/immune-brain/runtime module fails the boundary test naming the file and the import specifier, and bun test collects no file under tests/e2e/. Done looks like: tests/e2e-black-box-boundary.test.ts asserts both against fixtures.

attestations.summary: S2-AC1 smoke (tarball extract, loopback mock, pinned claude with ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL/--plugin-dir via spawning fake-herdr, cassette_mismatch negative, absent binary fails in beforeAll) and S2-AC2 boundary/collection tests with controls conform; blast radius medium: bunfig.toml pathIgnorePatterns changes global bun test collection and tests/fixtures/fake-herdr/herdr is a shared fixture whose non-spawn paths stay behavior-equivalent.

advisory_findings.summary: Supervisor writes <state>.<pane>.exit before appending the exit event, so waitForExit can observe done via settleExits and read the event log before the exit line lands.

evidence.trigger: agent wait returns as soon as the .exit file exists (settleExits) while the supervisor has not yet run emit(log, exit) -> FakeHerdr.waitForExit finds no exit event and returns null -> smoke test sees exitCode null instead of 0 (rare flake)

advisory_findings.summary: Under bun run e2e:record smoke, both claude tests route through the recorder: the mismatch test ignores its hand-built turns and rewrites cassettes/smoke/claude.jsonl, and mock-based assertions fail.

evidence.trigger: E2E_RECORD=1 with tests/e2e/smoke.e2e.ts -> startJourneyModel returns a recorder with mock undefined -> expect(run.model.mock?.requests).toHaveLength(1) fails and the mismatch case overwrites the smoke cassette with a second real-API recording

advisory_findings.summary: Boundary resolver ignores package self-reference through package.json exports, so a bare immune-brain/extensions/* import into .pi-extension is not reported (runtime/* itself is not exported, so the acceptance case stays covered).

evidence.trigger: tests/e2e/x.ts containing import immune-brain/extensions/index (package.json exports ./extensions/* -> ./plugins/immune-brain/.pi-extension/*) -> resolveSpecifier returns undefined -> boundaryViolations reports nothing
